name: South Kashmir & the Winter Valleys
description: A winter planning option that leaves the exact route responsive to conditions.

itinerary.title: Srinagar
itinerary.description: Arrive, meet the arranged transfer, and keep the first afternoon open around your journey.

itinerary.title: South Kashmir
itinerary.description: Travel towards the agreed valley base, choosing roads supported by current conditions.

itinerary.title: Valley exploration
itinerary.description: Take a gentle local outing or rest day; snow and activity access are not guaranteed.

itinerary.title: Countryside day
itinerary.description: Discuss suitable village or garden visits with the trip coordinator.

itinerary.title: Sind Valley
itinerary.description: Continue towards the Sind Valley if the route is suitable.

itinerary.title: Srinagar
itinerary.description: Return to Srinagar and leave room for changes to the winter plan.

itinerary.title: Srinagar departure
itinerary.description: Return for the agreed departure transfer. Allow a sensible road buffer before onward travel.
